title: Scissor Trail Safari
engine: shared trace-path engine with Pixi play field, recorded-music support, raster destinations, and strand-proof pointer tracing
shareTitle: Scissor Trail Safari — A Papercraft Finger Adventure
description: Guide friendly finger-scissors along straight, curvy, and spiral paper trails to rescue eight handcrafted safari friends.
learningGoals: Build pre-writing and scissor-readiness control on straight and angled paths
Practice smooth continuous movement through curves and changing directions
Sustain hand-eye steering around a complete inward spiral
interactionModel: choose a large animal trail card, start at the golden marker, and guide the raster scissors medallion continuously along forgiving dotted paper paths
feedbackModel: each checkpoint makes a gentle paper snip and turns the cut golden; off-path motion keeps earned progress, destinations bounce at rescue, and named spoken praise celebrates every animal

modes.title: Straight Trails
modes.skill: straight and gently angled directional control

modes.title: Curvy Trails
modes.skill: smooth S-curves, waves, and broad arches

modes.title: Spiral Trails
modes.skill: sustained circular steering toward a center target

credits: Original Papercraft raster art produced with OpenAI GPT Image 2, separated with the QLOBE exact-count cutter, and finalized through the shared cutout pipeline. Built with Codex for QLOBE Kids. See ASSETS.md.
